blocked: Withheld "Ferment in a clean, covered container.": Soaking, dehulling, milling or sprouting alone does not remove the heat-sensitive anti-nutrients (trypsin inhibitors). Do not present a soak-only, sprout-only or raw-flour preparation as ready to eat. Cook bean and groundnut preparations until they are fully done. (safety rule not yet reviewed by an expert)
